name: Mimic
description: This unit studies every ability an enemy casts within %cast_range% tiles of it, remembering it for %steal_window% turns. Cast Mimic on such an enemy to copy the last ability they used, wielding it as its own for %duration% turns. Only %max_abilities% copied ability can be held at a time - taking a new one discards the old, though a discarded copy keeps cooling down and returns with whatever cooldown it had left.
